source: src/tree/configSubtree.ts getConfigRootChildren ; existing: test-config-tree-view.cjs walks the tree but does not assert order or omission
title: Root sections appear in SECTIONS order, empty ones omitted
scenario: Build a model with entityTypes (2), relationTypes [] and sources (1); call getConfigRootChildren(model, uri).
expected: Items are Entity Types (2) then Sources (1) in SECTIONS order; empty relationTypes yields no folder; labels carry '(count)'.

title: Entity type children order and presence gating
scenario: Entity type with attributes, matchGroups, cleanseConfig, unmerge and no hidden; call getConfigNodeChildren on its item.
expected: Children: Browse Entities first, then Attributes, Match Groups, ..., Cleanse Config, Unmerge in code order; absent sections (Hidden Config) are not emitted.

title: Attributes grouped Nested, Reference, Simple and sorted by name
scenario: Attributes folder with mixed attrs named 'b','A','c' of nested/reference/simple kinds; expand it.
expected: All nested first, then reference, then simple; each group case-insensitively alphabetical; each jsonPath keeps the attribute's ORIGINAL array index.

title: contextValue and id scheme for config items
scenario: Create ConfigTreeItem for folder, item, attributesFolder under relationTypes, entityBrowser; with and without tenant URI.
expected: contextValue is reltio.folder.<type> or reltio.item.<type>; attributesFolder/nestedAttribute under relationTypes get '.relationType' suffix; id is '<uri>|<path>' (plus '|browseEntities' for entityBrowser).

title: Two tenants' identical config paths get distinct node ids
scenario: Call getConfigRootChildren with tenant URI A and again with B for the same model; compare ids.
expected: Same jsonPath yields different ids per tenant URI, so expanded state does not collide across tenants; child items inherit the parent's tenantL3Uri.

title: Browse Entities URIs for abstract types include concrete descendants only
scenario: Abstract type A, concrete B extends A, C extends B, D unrelated; plus a cyclic extendsTypeURI pair.
expected: Abstract A returns [B, C] (transitive); concrete type returns itself; unrelated D excluded; cyclic chain terminates without hanging.

title: Parent lookup for section children
scenario: Call getConfigTreeItemParent for an item at ['entityTypes',0] and for a path of length 1.
expected: Returns the Entity Types (n) folder item carrying the element's tenantL3Uri; returns undefined for root-level paths.

title: Environment contextValue and description per auth/eState
scenario: Construct EnvironmentNode for each combo of isAuthorized, canBrowserLogin and the 4 EStates.
expected: contextValue is reltio.environment.{authorized|unauthorized}[.oauthReady|.oauthBlocked], with '.noTenants' appended only for E_AUTHED_NO_TENANTS; description/tooltip follow eState; id is 'env:<name>'.

source: src/tree/multiTenantNodes.ts TenantNode ; existing: test-context-menu-reorganization.cjs pins package.json menus, not node values
title: Tenant contextValue, description and click command
scenario: Construct TenantNode for hasL3 true/false, isGitBound, branch set, stale local unauthenticated, each TState (vscode stub config tenantSingleClickOpen true/false).
expected: contextValue reltio.tenant[.l3][.gitbound]; description '(local)' when stale and unauthed else TState hint, plus branch marker; command is reltio.fetchL3 for T_NO_L3 else reltio.openL3, absent when setting is false.

title: Tenant, folder, history ids are stable and unique per env/tenant
scenario: Build TenantNode, BusinessConfigFolderNode, HistoryFolderNode, GitFolderNode for same names in two envs.
expected: Ids use tenant:, businessConfig:, history:, gitFolder: prefixes with env/tenant; same tenant id in two envs gives different ids; History contextValue has '.empty' suffix at zero snapshots.

title: Root lists environments, env expands to tenants with state
scenario: Provider with stub EnvironmentManager (2 envs, tenants), TokenStore with token for one env; call getChildren() then getChildren(envNode).
expected: Root returns one EnvironmentNode per env with authorized flag from TokenStore; env children are TenantNodes with TState from uxState or T_NO_L3 default; unknown env returns [].

title: Tenant children: Business Config only with L3, Workflows never in git mode
scenario: Expand TenantNode with hasL3 true/false for a normal env and for an env with GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN.
expected: With L3: Business Config folder then Workflows folder; without L3: Workflows only; git source tenants get no Workflows folder.

title: Git source tree: folders first, sorted, then configs sorted by label
scenario: Stub getGitSources with folders [DP/dp_lif], [DP], [] and several labels; call getChildren on git env node and a GitFolderNode.
expected: Folder rows precede config rows; folders sorted with localeCompare and de-duplicated; configs sorted by label else tenantId; rows are Expanded and default to T_READY.

title: Tree refresh is debounced and only on relevant documents
scenario: Call onL3DocumentChanged 5 times within 150 ms for BusinessConfig.json and once for notes.txt; count onDidChangeTreeData fires.
expected: Exactly one change event fires after about 150 ms for the config burst; notes.txt, or any non L3/history path, never triggers one; matching is case-insensitive for businessconfig.json.

source: src/tree/multiTenantTreeProvider.ts removeTenant / removeEnvironment ; existing: test-multi-tenant-tree-view.cjs source assertions pin the marker clearing
title: Removal clears workflow cache and History marker
scenario: Mark history exposed and load workflow cache for env/t1, call removeTenant then removeEnvironment, then re-check.
expected: Workflow cache and exposed marker for the tenant/env are gone; marker stays in-memory only.

title: Lazy commands: entity browser, reveal in editor, snapshot open
scenario: Call resolveTreeItem with a ConfigTreeItem entityBrowser, a plain ConfigTreeItem, a HistorySnapshotNode, a TenantNode.
expected: entityBrowser gets reltio.browseEntities; other config items get reltio.revealInEditor; snapshots get vscode.open with fileUri; an item with an existing command is not overwritten.

source: src/ux/uxState.ts deriveUxState ; existing: test-setup-ux-redesign.cjs covers empty, needs auth, no tenants, no L3, ready only
title: EState derivation: OAuth-only, git source and authed branches
scenario: Run deriveUxState with env having OAuth client and no token; with GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN via getToken; with token and tenants.
expected: No token + OAuth gives E_HAS_OAUTH_NO_SESSION; git source always E_READY even with no token; token with tenants gives E_READY; global is G_NEEDS_AUTH when nothing is authed.

title: Global state ladder and TState transitions
scenario: Cases: authed env without tenants; tenant hasL3 but file not in openedL3Files; then add its l3FileUri to the set.
expected: G_NEEDS_TENANT, then T_L3_NEVER_OPENED with global G_READY (L3 present), then T_READY; tenantCount and envCount reported correctly.

title: Bus is payload-free and context keys are published
scenario: Subscribe two listeners, fire(); call publish* with the vscode stub recording executeCommand.
expected: Both listeners fire once with no payload; setContext called with reltio.uxState=<global> and reltio.workspaceSource=<source> (null when undefined); dispose stops events.

title: Recent hosts and tenants: MRU order, dedupe, cap 10
scenario: Fake Memento; push 12 distinct hosts, then re-push the 5th; push 12 tenants under host X and 1 under host Y.
expected: Newest first; re-push moves to front without duplicate; list capped at 10 (oldest dropped); tenant lists are per host and do not affect each other.

source: src/ux/recents.ts auth method and opened L3 persistence
title: Last auth method and opened-L3 set round-trip safely
scenario: Save 'browser' then load; seed Memento with garbage string; save/load opened L3 Set.
expected: Valid values round-trip; unknown stored value loads as undefined; opened L3 set round-trips via array and an empty Memento yields an empty Set.

title: Production hosts CSV is parsed once, tolerant of CRLF and missing file
scenario: Stub workspace.fs.readFile returning 'a.com' CRLF, blank line, ' b.com ' then a rejecting read in a fresh module instance.
expected: Lines trimmed, blanks removed -> ['a.com','b.com']; second call is cached (no second read); read failure yields [] without throwing.

title: Status bar label and command per global state
scenario: Stub createStatusBarItem; render each GState plus G_READY with 1 env/0 tenants, 1 env/1 tenant, 2 envs/3 tenants.
expected: Labels: Add an environment, Sign in required, Add a tenant, Fetch L3 with matching commands; G_READY shows 'Reltio: N env(s), M tenant(s)' with correct pluralization; 1 env/0 tenants hides the item.

title: Status bar hidden with no workspace folder and empty state
scenario: render(G_EMPTY state, hasWorkspaceFolder=false), then with true.
expected: First call hides the item (show not called); second shows 'Reltio: Add an environment' bound to reltio.launchSetupWizard.

title: Quick switch pick list text and empty-state message
scenario: Stub EnvironmentManager.scanEnvironments with 0 envs, then envs with 0, 1 and 3 tenants; capture showQuickPick items.
expected: Zero envs: info message 'No Reltio environments configured.' and no pick; items describe 'No tenants', '1 tenant', '3 tenants'; cancel (undefined) does nothing further.

title: Quick switch focuses explorer and auto-opens the single L3
scenario: Pick an env with exactly one L3 tenant, then one with two L3 tenants; record executeCommand and openTextDocument calls.
expected: Both focus workbench.view.extension.reltioExplorer; only the single-L3 env opens that tenant's getL3Uri document; multi-L3 opens nothing.

title: Tenant row guidance advances as UX state advances
scenario: Using stub provider, set UxState T_NO_L3 -> T_L3_NEVER_OPENED -> T_READY and read TenantNode description/command each time.
expected: Descriptions: 'L3 not fetched - click to fetch' (command fetchL3), 'Open L3 to start editing' (openL3), then none. Real-click flow is manual QA (Tier C).

source: package.json contributes.menus view/item/context (environment nodes) ; existing: test-context-menu-reorganization.cjs covers tenant-node ordering only; extend with environment nodes
title: Environment context menu entries gated by auth and workspace source
scenario: Parse package.json; for each environment viewItem when-clause check workspaceSource != 'git' and which contextValue variants match.
expected: Sign-in items only match unauthorized.oauthReady; token/OAuth config items match oauthBlocked; no tenant-connectivity entries show in git workspaces; all referenced commands are declared.

source: package.json contributes.menus view/item/context (tenant nodes) ; existing: test-context-menu-reorganization.cjs, test-copy-tenant-id-to-clipboard.cjs
title: Tenant menu section order and Copy Tenant ID entry
scenario: Reuse tenant-menu bucket parse; assert bucket order and that tenant-id copy command exists on reltio.tenant and reltio.tenant.l3.
expected: Section order getconfig < apply < insert < tenantid < delete holds; insert items keep documented order; copy tenant id is available on both tenant contextValues.

title: Tenant id extracted from any tree argument shape
scenario: Pass undefined, {tenantId}, {id:'tenant:env/t'}, label object, empty object.
expected: Returns tenantId, id suffix, then label; undefined for undefined or unusable input; never throws.

title: Corrupt or missing L3 file yields empty Business Config, not an error
scenario: Stub fs.readFile to throw, then to return invalid JSON; expand BusinessConfigFolderNode.
expected: Children contain no config sections (History may appear); no exception propagates to the tree; text of an already-open editor document is preferred over disk.

title: Large model expansion stays fast and complete
scenario: Synthesize a model with 5,000 entity types each with 20 attributes; time getConfigRootChildren and expanding one folder and one type.
expected: Root plus folder expansion completes in under 1 s on CI hardware; returned item count equals array length; ids unique. Use generous threshold to avoid flakiness.

title: Many tenants in one environment resolve concurrently
scenario: Stub manager with 200 tenants; identity/git lookups stubbed with 5 ms delay; time getChildren(envNode).
expected: 200 TenantNodes returned, all ids unique, total time far below serial sum because tenants resolve via Promise.all. Note git state is looked up twice per tenant (not asserted).

title: Burst of edits does not flood tree refresh
scenario: Fire onL3DocumentChanged 1,000 times in a tight loop; count change events after timers settle.
expected: One change event total; the debounce timer is reset per call rather than stacked.

title: Recents tolerate empty or bad stored data and do not mutate it
scenario: Seed Memento with undefined and with a non-array for a host key; push; compare original map object reference.
expected: Push succeeds on empty store; the previously stored map object is not mutated in place (a copy is written); only host and tenant strings are stored (no tokens).

title: Status bar timer restores background and item disposes
scenario: Use fake timers; call flashSuccess then advance 1500 ms; call dispose.
expected: Background set to warning ThemeColor then restored to the original after 1500 ms; dispose disposes the underlying item.

title: Node fields never include tokens or secrets
scenario: Construct nodes with token-like strings in env/tenant names and inspect tooltip, description, id, command arguments.
expected: Only env name, tenant id, branch and fixed hint text appear; no token, credential or file contents are copied into node fields.

title: Tree behavior with Windows paths and URIs
scenario: Build ConfigTreeItem ids from vscode.Uri.file('C:\ws\a b\BusinessConfig.json'); call onL3DocumentChanged with a Windows-style path.
expected: Ids stay deterministic and unique with spaces and backslashes; refresh matching uses lowercased path suffix. Real UI rendering across OSes is manual QA (Tier C).
